project_meta.title: PowerShell vs CMD: The Ultimate Showdown

global_style.art_style: Clean professional whiteboard comparison video, bright white background, realistic photographic images of computer interfaces and technology, simple hand-drawn black stickman presenter, minimal black typography, subtle colored highlights, clean arrows and circles, modern educational entertainment aesthetic, consistent left-right comparison layout. CMD always appears on the left and PowerShell always appears on the right. Keep all text readable and visuals uncluttered.
global_style.negative_prompt: No cartoon computer interfaces, no distorted terminal screenshots, no gibberish text, no excessive decorations, no dark backgrounds, no unnecessary characters, no watermarks, no logos invented, no inconsistent stickman design, no 3D cartoon style, no cluttered layouts.

whiteboard.label: Comparison Whiteboard
whiteboard.visual_dna: A clean bright whiteboard studio with a pure white background, subtle paper texture, plenty of negative space, and a consistent two-column comparison layout. Left side reserved for CMD, right side reserved for PowerShell, presenter positioned near the bottom center.

stickman.label: Stickman Presenter
stickman.visual_dna: A simple hand-drawn black stickman with a round head, thin black limbs, expressive minimal facial features, white body with black outlines, consistent proportions, friendly and curious personality.

cmd_terminal.label: Command Prompt
cmd_terminal.visual_dna: Authentic Windows Command Prompt interface, black terminal background, white monospace text, realistic Windows command-line appearance, recognizable CMD window.

powershell_terminal.label: PowerShell
powershell_terminal.visual_dna: Authentic Windows PowerShell interface, dark blue terminal background, white monospace text, realistic PowerShell command-line appearance, recognizable PowerShell window.

old_computer.label: Old Computer
old_computer.visual_dna: A vintage personal computer with a bulky CRT monitor, keyboard, and an old-fashioned computing appearance, representing early personal computing.

modern_computer.label: Modern Computer
modern_computer.visual_dna: A contemporary desktop computer with a slim monitor, modern keyboard, and clean professional appearance.

process_data.label: Process Information
process_data.visual_dna: A clean visual representation of computer processes with readable columns for process name, CPU usage, and memory usage, arranged as structured information cards.

automation_icons.label: Automation Symbols
automation_icons.visual_dna: Simple recognizable symbols representing automated computer tasks, folders, files, scripts, network connections, and system administration.

os_logos.label: Operating Systems
os_logos.visual_dna: Recognizable official-style visual representations of Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems, displayed as three separate clean symbols.

beats.narration_text: ये दोनों देखने में लगभग एक जैसे लगते हैं। दोनों में कमांड लिखते हैं और दोनों से कंप्यूटर को कंट्रोल कर सकते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.cmd_terminal} on the left and {assets.powershell_terminal} on the right, equally sized and clearly visible. Place {assets.stickman} at the bottom center looking confused at both terminals. Add a small question mark above the presenter's head.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the whiteboard layout and both terminal windows in their fixed left-right positions.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन क्या आपको पता है कि इनमें से एक दूसरे से कितना ज्यादा शक्तिशाली है?
beats.prompt_action: The stickman raises one hand toward the two terminals with a curious expression. Add a large question mark between the two terminal windows and a subtle spotlight around both.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Preserve both terminal windows. Change only the stickman's pose and add the question mark.

beats.narration_text: बाईं तरफ है सीएमडी, यानी कमांड प्रॉम्प्ट। और दाईं तरफ है पावरशेल।
beats.prompt_action: Highlight {assets.cmd_terminal} on the left with a clean label reading CMD. Highlight {assets.powershell_terminal} on the right with a clean label reading POWERSHELL. The stickman presenter points toward the left terminal.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Maintain the same terminal positions. Introduce the two subject labels and change the presenter's pointing direction.

beats.narration_text: दोनों कमांड लाइन टूल हैं, लेकिन सीएमडी मुख्य रूप से विंडोज़ के बेसिक कमांड चलाने के लिए बना था, जबकि पावरशेल को एडवांस्ड कमांड्स और ऑटोमेशन के लिए बनाया गया।
beats.prompt_action: Show a simple basic command symbol below {assets.cmd_terminal}. Show advanced automation gears and script symbols below {assets.powershell_terminal}. The stickman switches to pointing toward PowerShell.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the original terminal layout and labels. Add basic command and automation symbols underneath the respective terminals.

beats.narration_text: अब उम्र की बात करें तो सीएमडी काफी पुराना है। इसका इतिहास शुरुआती पीसी डॉस और विंडोज़ के समय से जुड़ा है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.old_computer} prominently on the left with a small timeline pointing toward the CMD terminal. The stickman looks toward the vintage computer with a surprised expression.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the whiteboard background. Replace the previous comparison symbols with the vintage computer and a historical timeline on the left.

beats.narration_text: वहीं पावरशेल दो हजार छह में आया और इसे माइक्रोसॉफ्ट ने ज्यादा एडवांस्ड सिस्टम मैनेजमेंट के लिए बनाया था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.modern_computer} on the right with a clear timeline marker reading 2006. Connect the timeline visually to {assets.powershell_terminal}. The stickman turns toward the right side.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Retain the vintage computer on the left. Add the modern computer and 2006 timeline marker on the right.

beats.narration_text: अब एक ही काम करके देखते हैं। कंप्यूटर में कौन-कौन से प्रोग्राम चल रहे हैं?
beats.prompt_action: Display {assets.cmd_terminal} on the left and {assets.powershell_terminal} on the right, both ready for typing. The stickman stands between them holding a small magnifying glass and looking at both screens.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Remove the vintage and modern computer visuals. Return to the standard two-terminal comparison layout.

beats.narration_text: सीएमडी में आप टास्कलिस्ट लिखेंगे। जबकि पावरशेल में गेट प्रोसेस।
beats.prompt_action: Show the command tasklist being typed inside {assets.cmd_terminal}. Simultaneously show Get-Process being typed inside {assets.powershell_terminal}. Keep both commands readable and correctly spelled.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Preserve both terminal interfaces. Add only the respective commands inside each terminal.

beats.narration_text: दोनों आपको चल रहे प्रोसेसेज़ दिखा देंगे। लेकिन असली अंतर अभी बाकी है!
beats.prompt_action: Show a list of running processes appearing underneath both terminals. The stickman raises an index finger with an excited expression, signaling that a bigger difference is coming.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep both command examples visible. Add process lists and change the presenter's pose.

beats.narration_text: सीएमडी आमतौर पर कमांड का आउटपुट टेक्स्ट के रूप में देता है।
beats.prompt_action: Zoom toward {assets.cmd_terminal}. Display simple plain-text command output as several lines of white monospace text. Add a small label reading PLAIN TEXT. The stickman points toward the output.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Focus on CMD. Keep the terminal appearance authentic and display only plain-text output.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन पावरशेल की सबसे बड़ी ताकत है इसके ऑब्जेक्ट्स। यानी यह सिर्फ टेक्स्ट नहीं, बल्कि डेटा की प्रॉपर्टीज़ भी समझता है।
beats.prompt_action: Zoom toward {assets.powershell_terminal}. Transform the visual output into structured data cards based on {assets.process_data}. Highlight process name, CPU usage, and memory usage as separate properties. Add a label reading STRUCTURED OBJECTS.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Shift visual focus from CMD to PowerShell. Introduce structured process information cards and property highlights.

beats.narration_text: आप किसी प्रोसेस को उसके नाम, मेमोरी या सीपीयू इस्तेमाल के आधार पर आसानी से फिल्टर कर सकते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.powershell_terminal} with the command Get-Process | Where-Object CPU -gt 10. Highlight CPU values above 10 in the structured process cards. The stickman points at the highlighted results.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Retain the structured process cards. Add the filtering command and highlight matching CPU values.

beats.narration_text: ऑटोमेशन की बात करें तो सीएमडी बैच फाइल्स के जरिए बेसिक काम ऑटोमेट कर सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.cmd_terminal} next to a simple .bat batch file icon. Display a basic automated file operation with a folder and a check mark. The stickman points toward the CMD side.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Replace the process filtering demonstration with a basic CMD batch file automation example.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन पावरशेल में एडवांस्ड स्क्रिप्टिंग, सिस्टम मैनेजमेंट, फाइल हैंडलिंग और नेटवर्क एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन भी किया जा सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.powershell_terminal} surrounded by {assets.automation_icons}, including a PowerShell script file, folders, system settings, and network nodes. The stickman points toward the PowerShell side with an impressed expression.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the CMD batch example visible on the left. Introduce advanced PowerShell automation symbols on the right.

beats.narration_text: और एक मजेदार बात! सीएमडी मुख्य रूप से विंडोज़ तक सीमित है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.cmd_terminal} connected with a single Windows operating system symbol from {assets.os_logos}. The stickman points at the single connection.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Clear the automation symbols and show the CMD-to-Windows compatibility visual.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन पावरशेल का नया वर्जन विंडोज़ के अलावा लिनक्स और मैक पर भी चलता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.powershell_terminal} connected to three distinct operating system symbols from {assets.os_logos}: Windows, Linux, and macOS. The stickman looks impressed and gestures toward all three.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Retain the CMD compatibility visual on the left. Add Linux and macOS connections to the PowerShell side.

beats.narration_text: तो आखिर कौन बेहतर है? बेसिक कमांड्स और पुराने विंडोज़ टास्क के लिए सीएमडी काफी है।
beats.prompt_action: Show both {assets.cmd_terminal} and {assets.powershell_terminal} side by side. Highlight CMD with a clean label reading SIMPLE TASKS. The stickman stands in the center and points toward CMD.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Return to the original comparison layout. Remove the operating system symbols and highlight CMD for basic tasks.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन एडवांस्ड ऑटोमेशन और सिस्टम कंट्रोल के लिए पावरशेल आगे है।
beats.prompt_action: Highlight {assets.powershell_terminal} with a clean label reading ADVANCED AUTOMATION. Show subtle gear and system control symbols around it. The stickman points toward PowerShell.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep both terminals visible. Shift the highlight from CMD to PowerShell and change the presenter's pointing direction.

beats.narration_text: अब बताओ, अगला मुकाबला किन दो चीज़ों के बीच होना चाहिए?
beats.prompt_action: Show the stickman facing the viewer and pointing toward a large empty speech bubble for audience suggestions. Keep both terminal windows smaller in the background. Add a simple comment icon near the speech bubble.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Preserve the whiteboard style. Move the stickman into a viewer-facing pose and introduce the final audience question area.
